plugins.name: software-company
plugins.description: Complete software development company simulation with 12 roles (Product Manager, Project Manager, BA, SA, Architect, UX, Developer, Tester, DevOps, Security Engineer, Tech Writer, SEO), 28 specialized skills covering output templates + how-to patterns (auth, e2e-testing, architecture, runbooks) + office-document-handling (Word/Excel/PowerPoint/PDF) + branded-document-design (branded .docx/.pptx output with Thai typography) + windows-app-design (Fluent 2 UI for WinUI 3 / Avalonia / Electron desktop apps) + web-app-design (token-driven web app UI system with CI enforcement) + mobile-app-design (phone app UI with four-family typography and safe-area handling) + an engineering baseline set (logging-standards, testing-standards, web-service-essentials) with tested drop-in code for .NET/Node/Python/Angular, and 15 slash commands for full SDLC workflows. Each agent includes Initial Discovery and Performance Targets aligned with industry standards (DORA, OWASP, MoSCoW, RICE).

Requires software-company plugin for shared infrastructure.
